jobs_results.description:
Location Redstone Arsenal, Alabama

Salary Range $135,000-$165,000 annually

Clearance Active Secret clearance required at the time of hire

Citizenship U.S. citizenship required

About The Role

Tactica Solutions LLC is seeking an AI Integration Analyst to help turn emerging Artificial Intelligence and Generative AI capabilities into secure, practical tools for Department of Defense mission and business operations.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys building and evaluating AI solutions, improving business processes, and translating complex technical capabilities into tools that military and civilian stakeholders can use with confidence.

The ideal candidate is both a technical practitioner and a practical problem-solver. You should be comfortable developing Large Language Model applications, working with Retrieval-Augmented Generation architectures, evaluating AI risks, and determining when AI is—or is not—the right solution.

What You’ll Do

Develop, integrate, configure, test, and evaluate AI and Generative AI solutions that support business and mission operations.Build and improve Large Language Model applications, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation and agent-based workflows.Design RAG pipelines involving document ingestion, chunking, metadata, embeddings, vector databases, retrieval, reranking, and response generation.Evaluate business problems to determine whether they are best addressed through AI, conventional automation, process improvement, or a combination of approaches.Identify and help mitigate AI security and operational risks, includingUnauthorized disclosure of sensitive informationPrompt injectionInsecure tool or system accessHallucinated or unsupported outputsExcessive system permissionsInappropriate reliance on AI-generated informationDevelop human-in-the-loop review processes, evaluation methods, and safety guardrails for AI-enabled workflows.Translate complex AI technologies into clear, actionable tools and recommendations for non-technical military and civilian stakeholders.Present technical findings, demonstrations, risks, and implementation recommendations to leadership and mission partners.Develop user guides, standard operating procedures, process flows, training materials, technical documentation, and implementation plans.Manage multiple technical activities and priorities while meeting customer and program deadlines.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related technical discipline.Five or more years of professional experience in software integration, systems analysis, automation, data analytics, software development, or a related technical field.At least two years of hands-on experience developing, integrating, configuring, testing, or evaluating Artificial Intelligence or Generative AI solutions. These two years may be included within the five years of overall professional experience.Demonstrated experience developing or integrating Generative AI and Large Language Model applications for business or mission operations.Working knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation architecture, including document ingestion, chunking, metadata, embeddings, vector databases, retrieval, reranking, and response generation.Experience identifying and managing AI-related security, privacy, reliability, and operational risks.Ability to evaluate whether a problem is appropriate for AI or would be better addressed through conventional automation or process improvement.Ability to explain AI technologies, technical risks, and agent workflows clearly to non-technical stakeholders.Experience supporting the Department of Defense or another federal government organization.Familiarity with DoD Responsible Artificial Intelligence principles and applicable federal AI governance requirements.U.S. citizenship.Active Secret clearance at the time of hire.


Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are helpful but are not required for consideration

Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related technical discipline.Experience integrating AI capabilities within Palantir Foundry environments, including Maven, Army Vantage, or APAS.Experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, or related tools.Familiarity with military supply-chain, logistics, acquisition, or financial-management systems, such as GFEBS or GCSS-Army.Experience implementing human-in-the-loop workflows, AI evaluation processes, or safety guardrails in secure government or enterprise environments.Experience using AI safety or content-control technologies such as NeMo Guardrails, Llama Guard, or comparable frameworks.Experience developing technical documentation, user guides, standard operating procedures, training materials, process maps, and implementation documentation.Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities in a deadline-driven environment.Existing Top-Secret clearance.


Candidates who meet the required qualifications are encouraged to apply even if they do not meet every preferred qualification.

What Success Looks Like

A successful candidate will

Approach AI as a practical mission-enablement tool rather than applying AI to every problem.Balance innovation with security, reliability, governance, and responsible use.Build solutions that are understandable, testable, and maintainable.Work effectively with technical teams, program leadership, military personnel, and other mission stakeholders.Recognize when human review and decision authority must remain part of an AI-enabled process.Convert technical capabilities into workflows that provide measurable value to the customer.


Physical Requirements

This position is primarily computer-based and may involve sitting or standing for extended periods, typing, and reading from a computer screen.

The role may occasionally require bending, reaching, kneeling, or lifting items weighing up to 30 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be provided to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law.

Additional Information

This description provides a general overview of the position and is not intended to identify every possible responsibility. Duties and assignments may evolve based on customer mission requirements, program priorities, and business needs.

Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex—including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions—sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs_results.description:
Tunnell Government Services, Inc., is comprised of the industry's leading scientists, medical and technical experts, and human capital and organizational development professionals. We approach all projects as a team and are committed to helping our clients transform and quickly achieve strategic goals. If you are interested in joining an employee-owned company that develops and implements innovative, integrated and differentiated solutions, please click on the links below to find the job that is right for you and contact us.


    
   
  
 
 Title: Healthcare AI Evaluation and Risk Assessment Specialist


 


 Job Type: Full Time Employee


  Schedule: Monday through Friday (no Holidays)


  Location: This position is 100% telework


  Digital Health Center of Excellence (DHCoE), Office of Strategic Partnerships and Technology Innovation (OST), Center for Devices and Radiological Health (CDRH), FDA


  Position Summary


 The Healthcare AI Evaluation and Risk Assessment Specialist provides scientific, technical, and regulatory expertise supporting FDA's oversight of AI-enabled medical devices. The incumbent serves as a subject matter expert in the evaluation of emerging healthcare AI technologies, including generative AI, large language models (LLMs), foundation models, multimodal AI systems, and agentic AI, and their application in medical devices across clinical specialties. The position focuses on evaluating safety, effectiveness, performance, reliability, risk management, and evidence supporting AI-enabled medical devices and contributing to regulatory science, policy development, and review best practices. [fda.gov], [fda.gov]


  Major Duties and Responsibilities


 
  Review premarket submissions, IDE applications, and other regulatory submissions involving AI-enabled medical devices
  Evaluate AI model performance, validation strategies, benchmarking methodologies, and supporting evidence for safety and effectiveness
  Assess AI risk assessment and risk management approaches, including model failure modes, hallucinations, bias, automation bias, cybersecurity risks, human factors, post-market monitoring, and lifecycle management
  Evaluate model testing approaches, including benchmarking, robustness testing, subgroup analyses, uncertainty quantification, stress testing, and adversarial testing (red teaming)
  Identify scientific limitations of proposed evaluation designs, datasets, scoring methodologies, and validation approaches
  Assess evidence from clinical studies, reader studies, simulation-based evaluations, real-world evidence, and external validation studies
  Provide scientific consultation to multidisciplinary review teams on AI evaluation methodologies, evidence generation, transparency, explainability, governance, and performance monitoring
  Collaborate with FDA staff, other Federal agencies, academic institutions, healthcare organizations, standards development organizations, and industry stakeholders
  Contribute to the development of regulatory science, policy, guidance documents, review methodologies, and best practices related to healthcare AI and emerging digital health technologies
  Monitor advances in AI technologies and identify scientific challenges and opportunities relevant to FDA's regulatory mission
  Prepare technical reports, scientific reviews, briefing materials, presentations, and policy analyses
 
 Minimum Qualifications


 
  Master's degree or higher in artificial intelligence, machine learning, computer science, data science, biomedical engineering, health informatics, medicine, public health, or a related field
  At least seven (7) years of relevant experience in healthcare AI, medical devices, digital health, regulatory science, or related disciplines
  Demonstrated expertise in AI evaluation, risk assessment, evidence generation, and performance assessment methodologies
 
 Preferred Qualifications


 
  PhD, MD, DVM, PharmD, or other advanced scientific degree
  Experience supporting FDA or other Federal healthcare agencies
  Knowledge of:
  
   
    Generative AI and LLMs
    Foundation and multimodal models
    Software as a Medical Device (SaMD)
    Medical device regulatory pathways (510(k), De Novo, PMA, IDE)
    AI governance and Good Machine Learning Practice (GMLP)
    Medical device cybersecurity and real-world evidence
   
 
 Must be a US Citizen or Full Green Card holder.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.
